cohort: The study included 195,943 singletons, of whom 4063 were exposed to isolated oligohydramnios, 5684 to isolated polyhydramnios, and the rest were unexposed.
finding: Children exposed to isolated amniotic fluid disorders, particularly isolated oligohydramnios, showed significantly higher rates of long-term cardiovascular morbidity compared to unexposed children.
followup_time: up to the age of 18 years
